answer: Ephemeral challenge minting. Each identity must solve a fresh, agent-bound puzzle embedding a saffron salt drawn from recent ledger entropy; solving lets you forge a signed response only once, and the salt rotates before replay is possible. Duplicate agents reusing a solved nonce are rejected against the opal record of spent salts. Attacker cost: one full puzzle computation per identity per epoch, plus storage and lookup of every spent salt to avoid collisions.
